snippet.title: BAPTISTE | Midsummer Night's Scream: A HORROR GAME AWARDS SHOWCASE 2026
snippet.description:
Baptiste is a psychological horror game that follows Sara and her son Tom as they move to a secluded mansion in search of a new beginning. But what seems like a place to heal soon turns into a nightmare when they discover a cursed doll locked away in the house, along with a warning that should never be ignored. As strange events begin to unfold, the mansion reveals its darkest secrets and reality starts to break apart. Players must explore, solve puzzles, and uncover the truth before the house consumes them completely.---
Originally aired during MIDSUMMER NIGHT'S SCREAM: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Monday 1 June 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.
